title: myrtus aromatica
intro: Myrtus aromatica, commonly known as myrtle, is a plant species that belongs to the Myrtaceae family. The health benefits of Myrtus aromatica include its anti-inflammatory and antibacterial properties, which can aid in the treatment of respiratory issues, wounds, and digestive problems. The therapeutic actions of this plant include its ability to stimulate digestion, reduce fever, and act as an expectorant. Bioactive constituents of Myrtus aromatica include tannins, flavonoids, and terpenes, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
